Camouflaged against the bark of a tree, a tawny frogmouth (Podargus strigoides) stretches its wings covering two other birds from the forest rain in Perth, Australia. The bird's big eyes and bright yellow insides of its mouth is meant to frighten predators and potentially attract prey.
